priorities.summary: UTMStack's incident-command WebSocket handler (/command/{hostname} STOMP destination) applies no role check or command allowlist, so any authenticated user can send arbitrary OS commands via gRPC to every connected agent — which typically run as root/SYSTEM. Disclosed Oct 2 alongside six other UTMStack flaws; fixed in 11.2.16.

Sandbox escape in GitLab's self-hosted AI Gateway: a logged-in user with Duo Agent Platform access can craft a flow configuration that escapes the Jinja2 prompt-template sandbox and executes arbitrary commands on the gateway host (server-side, before any LLM invocation). Affects 18.1.6–19.4.0; operators must update the Gateway image itself to 19.2.4, 19.3.2 or 19.4.1.

ConvertX before 0.19.0 passes Calibre recipe files straight to the ebook-convert binary without blocking them, so executable code in a .recipe or .downloaded_recipe file runs on the host (CWE-829). Disclosed Oct 3; upgrade to 0.19.0 or later.

model.name: Gemini 4 Argon
model.summary: Google DeepMind's new frontier model (announced Sep 30) built for long-horizon software engineering, enterprise knowledge work and cybersecurity defense, with an industry-leading 1M output-token limit. Rollout is deliberately gated: it is available first only to vetted cyber defenders via Google's Fairwind Program (without cyber guardrails for them) at $2/$10 per million input/output tokens, with broader API access to follow.
